tldr_zh: OpenAI強化隱私保護與安全措施，Waymo無人計程車擴展，AI安全政策與企業競爭日趨激烈。
tldr_en: OpenAI enhances privacy protections and safety measures; Waymo expands robotaxi access; AI safety policies and enterprise competition intensify.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推出零數據保留政策與隱私安全處理
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Zero Data Retention and Private Safety Processing
items.summary_zh: OpenAI為符合條件的API客戶確認零數據保留政策，並推出Private Safety Processing功能，在不損害數據隱私的前提下實現先進AI安全防護。這是OpenAI應對隱私和安全雙重需求的重要舉措，標誌著企業AI服務的新標準。
items.summary_en: OpenAI confirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing, enabling advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy. This represents OpenAI's commitment to balancing enterprise needs with strong privacy protections.

items.title_zh: OpenAI與Replit推出GPT-5.6 Luna免費軟體開發模式
items.title_en: Replit Expands AI Software Creation with GPT-5.6 Luna Free Mode
items.summary_zh: Replit推出Free Mode，由GPT-5.6 Luna支持，用戶無需擔心Token成本即可將創意轉化為可運行的軟體。此舉大幅降低AI編程工具的使用門檻，使更廣泛的開發者能夠受益於先進AI能力。
items.summary_en: Replit launches Free Mode powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, allowing users to create working software without token cost concerns. This significantly lowers barriers to entry for AI-powered development tools.

items.title_zh: OpenAI助力民主國家加強國家安全AI監督
items.title_en: OpenAI Strengthens Democratic Oversight of AI in National Security
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出新計劃，為政府機構提供工具、培訓與專業知識，強化民主國家對國安領域AI應用的監督。這反映出OpenAI在推動AI技術同時，主動承擔社會責任的努力。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches initiative providing tools, training, and expertise to government institutions to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security. This demonstrates the company's commitment to responsible AI deployment.

items.title_zh: Waymo廉價新一代無人計程車開放三城市預約
items.title_en: Waymo's Cheaper Next-Gen Robotaxi Expands to Three Cities
items.summary_zh: Waymo推出定位更親民的新一代無人計程車Waymo Ojai，已在三個城市開放給所有用戶體驗。該車型是Waymo實現規模化與最終盈利的關鍵，標誌著無人駕駛計程車邁向主流市場。
items.summary_en: Waymo launches Waymo Ojai, a more affordable next-generation robotaxi, expanding access to three cities. The vehicle is central to Waymo's path to mass scale and profitability.

items.title_zh: OpenAI與Anthropic競爭企業隱私保護功能
items.title_en: OpenAI Competes with Anthropic Over Enterprise Privacy Protections
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出新的客戶隱私保護機制，與競爭對手Anthropic展開企業客戶隱私防護的競賽。雙方在此領域的競爭凸顯了企業對數據安全的重視，將成為AI企業服務的核心差異化因素。
items.summary_en: OpenAI introduces new privacy protections competing with Anthropic for enterprise customers. The competition highlights data security as a critical differentiator in enterprise AI services.

items.title_zh: 亞馬遜配送無人機目標2026年底覆蓋500個美國社區
items.title_en: Amazon Aims to Expand Prime Air Drones to 500 Neighborhoods by End of 2026
items.summary_zh: 亞馬遜宣布其Prime Air配送無人機計劃到2026年底覆蓋500個美國社區。該擴展計劃代表無人機物流商業化的重要進展，但也引發了隱私和安全方面的廣泛討論。
items.summary_en: Amazon targets expansion of Prime Air delivery drones to 500 US neighborhoods by end of 2026. This expansion represents significant progress in commercializing drone logistics while raising privacy and safety concerns.

items.title_en: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter to Strengthen Enterprise AI Integration
items.summary_zh: 支付巨頭Stripe收購AI模型路由初創公司OpenRouter。雖然Stripe宣稱與AI奇點相關，但實質上是為支付和企業應用深度整合AI能力，反映科技公司加速AI布局的趨勢。
items.summary_en: Stripe acquires OpenRouter, a startup that routes prompts between different AI models. Beyond the stated singularity rationale, the acquisition enables deeper AI integration for payments and enterprise applications.

items.title_zh: Google Gemini推出學生專用工作區助力學習
items.title_en: Google Gemini Launches Student Hub for Back-to-School Season
items.summary_zh: Google在Gemini中推出專為學生設計的工作區，支援研究筆記、閃卡製作、練習測驗等功能，並新增圖表與圖像支援。此舉展現Google對教育市場的重視。
items.summary_en: Google rolls out dedicated student hub in Gemini with features for research notes, flashcards, and practice quizzes, plus enhanced support for graphs and images. This targets the growing education market.

items.title_zh: 明美國4漏洞遭積極利用，政府機構需緊急修補
items.title_en: CISA Warns of Four Critical Vulnerabilities Being Actively Exploited
items.summary_zh: 美國網路安全部門CISA警告四個重大漏洞正遭積極利用，涉及Windows、macOS、SharePoint與VMware vCenter，聯邦機構須在8月21日前完成修補。這些漏洞風險等級極高，需立即處理。
items.summary_en: CISA warns that four critical vulnerabilities affecting Windows, macOS, SharePoint, and VMware vCenter are being actively exploited. Federal agencies must patch by August 21, highlighting urgent security threats.

items.title_zh: 以色列首度承認士兵開槍射殺加薩5歲女童
items.title_en: Israel Confirms Soldiers Fired at Car Killing Palestinian Girl Hind Rajab
items.summary_zh: 以色列軍方首度承認旗下部隊曾向載有5歲巴勒斯坦女童欣德·拉賈布的車輛開火，導致其死亡，並已啟動刑事調查。此決定引發國際關注，凸顯加薩人道危機的嚴重性。
items.summary_en: Israel confirms soldiers fired at the car containing five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab, leading to her death, and has opened a criminal investigation. The decision draws international attention to Gaza's humanitarian crisis.

items.title_zh: 中東緊張升級　油價升至三週高點
items.title_en: Middle East Tensions Rise as Oil Prices Climb to Three-Week High
items.summary_zh: 阿聯酋與伊朗緊張局勢升級，市場預期霍爾木茲海峽可能長期關閉，導致原油價格升至三週多以來最高。能源價格上漲將影響全球經濟。
items.summary_en: Escalating tensions between UAE and Iran, with market expectations of prolonged Hormuz Strait closure, drive crude oil prices to three-week highs. Energy price increases will impact global economies.

items.title_zh: 川普稱北韓擁57枚核武　計劃年內會晤金正恩
items.title_en: Trump Claims North Korea Has 57 Nuclear Weapons, Plans 2026 Meeting with Kim
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普表示與金正恩關係良好，計劃今年稍晚會晤。川普聲稱北韓擁57枚核武，並宣布美韓軍演規模將縮減。此舉引發對朝鮮半島政策的關注。
items.summary_en: Trump states plans to meet Kim Jong Un later this year citing good relations and claims North Korea possesses 57 nuclear weapons. U.S.-South Korea military exercises will be reduced, raising concerns about peninsula security policy.
